correctness.rationale: The mechanical rotation cells have n+1 distinct factor codes, with boundary β_j swapping adjacent 01/10 at rank ceil(jα). T^k deletes the first min(k,#ones) ones and appends them, so exactly cuts j with j<=floor(k/α) merge; retained weight cuts distinguish others. A rightmost-remaining-digit argument rules out nonlocal collisions. Thus ρ=max(2,n+1-floor(k/α)) for all n,k>=1, including n=1. The older full proof also derives monotone phase-ordered images. Independent direct mechanical-factor/tortoise simulation matched 1,332 (α,n,k) checks across four irrational slopes, n<=37,k<=9; this does not substitute for the all-slope proof.
